observed_failure.symptom: two </html> closers and 17,211 bytes of duplicated source after the first document close
observed_failure.consequence: duplicate runtime code executed and broke a legacy READFIELD reader-mode invariant while feature-local axial proof still passed

delta: Add a tiny HTML tail checker.
Apply it to every manifest-addressed HTML document during existing public static validation.
Reject duplicate closing html tags and non-whitespace bytes after a closing html tag.
Allow fragment-like HTML with no closing html tag so embedded/static fragments are not reclassified.
boundary: This detects document-tail corruption, not general HTML validity or browser semantic correctness.
